title: observability: token-level cost & latency dashboards, tracing enhancements, and alert tuning
author: Asha Menon
release_notes: Add token-level cost and latency dashboards, enrich tracing for token spans, and tune alerts (p95 latency and token-cost anomalies). Includes runbooks and remediation steps for SRE.
description:
Context: Customers and internal teams need better visibility into per-token economics and tail latency for generation workloads. This PR introduces token-level metrics, dashboard panels, improved tracing spans for token emission, and tuned alerts so SRE can identify cost regressions and latency tails quickly.

Goal: Provide actionable dashboards and alerting to catch regressions in token-level cost and p95/p99 latency, and add tracing hooks to attribute regressions to model variants, batching behavior, or KV cache effectiveness.

What this changes: 1) Telemetry: new Prometheus metrics (token_cost_total, token_count, token_latency_seconds_bucket by model_variant, route, customer_tier, kv_cache_hit). 2) Tracing: add token emission spans with attributes (token_index, tokenizer_latency_ms, backend_latency_ms, kv_cache_hit). 3) Dashboards: Grafana panels for token-cost-per-request, token-cost-breakdown, token-latency p50/p95/p99 heatmaps, KV cache hit-rate, and model-variant comparisons. 4) Alerts: tuned rules for token-cost anomaly (adaptive threshold with baseline) and p95 latency exceedance with noise-filtering and a two-stage alert (warn -> page). 5) Runbooks & docs: runbook added and example queries for triage.

Checklist:
- [x] Define metrics and labels with low-cardinality defaults
- [x] Implement instrumentation in serving runtime and API proxy
- [x] Add tracing spans and ensure sampling respects existing policies
- [x] Create Grafana dashboards and panels with template vars
- [x] Add alert rules and runbooks
- [x] Unit + integration tests for metrics emission
- [x] SRE review and sign-off

Notes: Kept metric label cardinality limited (model_variant, route, customer_tier). Token attributes are optional in traces to avoid high-volume tag explosion; they are sampled at 1% by default and configurable. Related Linear: ENG-1423 and SRE-219.
